sentences.text: This white shark's track begins on {first_date} and runs for {days_tracked}.
White sharks from the California coast travel offshore to a mid-Pacific area between California and Hawaii that researchers call the White Shark Café.
On {farthest_date} it was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began, {species_rank_distance}.
Its southernmost position was {southernmost_lat}, and the last is from {last_date}.
